title: Blackrock Spire
directions: Getting in: The entrance is inside Blackrock Mountain, close to the Depths. Groups run the Lower Spire first and then the Upper Spire.

title: Blackrock Depths
directions: Getting in: The entrance is inside Blackrock Mountain, which you reach from Searing Gorge or Burning Steppes. The Spire and Molten Core entrances are nearby.

title: Onyxia's Lair
directions: Getting in: In Classic each faction has an attunement questline that ends with the Drakefire Amulet, which you need to enter. The lair is in the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh.

title: Scholomance
directions: Getting in: The entrance is in the Western Plaguelands. Groups run the bosses in a loop through the school: Kirtonos, the Barov rooms and then Gandling.

title: City of Dalaran
Excavation Site: Wetlands

entrances.attribution: (Forever client, our match: the only instance-portal model on the route)

title: Ruins of Lordaeron
Zul'Gurub
directions: Getting in: In Classic the entrance is open to everyone: there is no attunement. It lies in northern Stranglethorn Vale.

title: Stratholme
directions: Getting in: The entrance is in the Eastern Plaguelands. There are two routes: the Main Gate (the Crimson side: Forresten, Timmy, Malor, Willey, Galford and Balnazzar) and the Service Gate (the undead: the Unforgiven, Anastari, Nerub'enkan, Maleki, Barthilas, Ramstein and Baron Rivendare). Most groups run the Service Gate for Rivendare and his mount drop, or the Main Gate for Balnazzar.

title: Shadowfang Keep
directions: Getting in: The entrance is in Silverpine Forest. Both factions can enter.

title: Maraudon
directions: Getting in: The entrance is in Desolace.

title: Ragefire Chasm
directions: Getting in: The entrance is in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. Horde players walk in from the city; Alliance players can enter too, but must get through Orgrimmar first.

title: Dire Maul
directions: Getting in: The entrance is in Feralas. The wings are separate: East (satyrs and the Warpwood), West (the Capital Gardens) and North (the Gordok Commons). Most groups run one wing at a time; North is popular for the Gordok tribute.

title: Wailing Caverns
directions: Getting in: The entrance is in the Barrens. Both factions can enter.

title: Razorfen Kraul
directions: Getting in: The entrance is in the Barrens. Both factions can enter.

title: Blackfathom Deeps
directions: Getting in: The entrance is on the coast of Ashenvale. Both factions can enter.

title: Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj
directions: Getting in: The outer gate in Silithus has to be opened first. In Classic that came from a server-wide event, and there is no attunement for the raid itself.

title: Ahn'Qiraj Temple
directions: Getting in: In Classic there is no personal attunement quest: the temple's gates are opened for the whole server. Whether Forever works the same way hasn't been said.

title: Naxxramas
directions: Getting in: In Classic you need Honored with the Argent Dawn to take the attunement quest, The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas, from Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel; it costs less gold at Revered and nothing at Exalted. Whether Forever uses the same steps hasn't been said.

title: Gnomeregan
directions: Getting in: The entrance is in Dun Morogh.

title: Scarlet Monastery
directions: Getting in: The entrance is in Tirisfal Glades, at the Monastery's front gate. Each wing has its own door inside.

title: Zul'Farrak
directions: Getting in: The entrance is in the Tanaris desert. Gadgetzan, the nearest town, has a flight point for the Alliance.

title: Uldaman
directions: Getting in: The entrance is in the Badlands. Kargath is the nearest Horde flight point.

title: Razorfen Downs
directions: Getting in: The entrance is in the Barrens.
